propositions: The idempotency test patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and related operations to binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the blast radius narrowed and would miss regressions that make clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally.
clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window idempotency pass because both call sites are gated on out-of-window-but-alive keys and the fixture seeds all keys in-window.
The fix requires patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules to restore the integration oracle's reach.
